name: Nemorsys
detailed_description:
An ultimate challenge for the daring souls. The fight for your humanity will be relentless. Darkness lies dormant within each of us... One wrong decision, and your light will flicker into the shadows.

Join Kaelara on her quest for revenge against a tyrannical king.

In her desperation, she summons the ancient spirit of darkness, the Nemorsis, to overthrow the evil ruler and his minions.

Step into the shadows in this rogue-like stealth game.

Wield shadow-based powers to navigate your way to the king. Engage in intense combat with a diverse array of enemies and formidable bosses while remaining unseen. Traverse a labyrinth of rooms, each offering unique encounters and puzzles, as you inch closer to your ultimate goal.

Key Features:

  • Roster of 20 Unique Shadow-Based Skills: Obtain these skills randomly, forcing you to adapt your play style with each run. Each skill can be upgraded up to level 5, with every second level introducing additional shadow-based mechanics.

  • A Vast Array of Puzzles and Traps: Navigate through intricate puzzles and avoid deadly traps.

  • In-Depth Stealth System: Utilize the field of view, ambient shadow levels, and character distances. Your actions directly influence your stealthiness.

  • Expansive Single-Player Campaign: Journey through diverse environments including a dungeon, village, castle, temple, and a hellish landscape.

  • Challenging AI System: Face enemies with unique behaviors and a keen field of view, making each encounter unpredictable.

  • Dynamic Fog of War: Experience an animated fog of war that changes based on your character’s field of view.

  • Randomized Reward System: Each run offers unique rewards, requiring strategic choices between different options.

  • Permanent Progression System: as you die and you progress you earn permanent skills and point to improve you character.

Embrace the darkness. Fulfill your vengeance and overthrow the king.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon R9 270X with 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 with 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature themes and graphic content that may not be suitable for all players. Expect to encounter scenes of gore, violence, and references to suicide, sacrifice, corruption, torture, and murder. These elements are integral to the storyline and atmosphere, providing a dark and immersive experience. Player discretion is advised.
